item.title: Bound by the Rules: War's Morality and the Just Defender
item.description: This is not one war fought by two comparable armies. It is two different things at once: a years-long campaign to exterminate a civilian population, and a disciplined defense that strikes only military and economic targets. The difference in conduct follows from a difference in stakes — survival against empire — and only one side makes war on civilians.

item.title: Two Roots of Rus: Why Ukraine Is Not Russia
item.description: "One people" is the founding lie of this war. Ukraine and Russia forked in the Middle Ages from two different roots — Lithuanian Rus and Muscovy — and that civilizational split, not genetics, is why Ukraine is genuinely not Russia.
